title: Freeze Frame asks how long, and inserts a freeze you can resize, on that track only
goal: Freeze Frame should insert a visible freeze segment on the clip's own track at the playhead, which the person can drag longer or shorter like any clip, with a small sheet or popover to type the length (any length, for example 10 s) instead of a submenu of fixed choices. It freezes only that track; other tracks keep playing unless the person asks for every track.
notes:
User's words (2026-10-17): "Also the title pages are interesting with the backgrounds, but still feel like.. if apple were presenting, they would be embarrassing. They don't look like professionally designed. They look interesting for a high school student presentation. I need them to be apple-level quality of design and polish. Also i find the 3d transforms completely unusable and confusing. I try to create a title page. Drag it there, then move my video clip to follow it. How am i supposed to change the transition between the title and clip to a cube, for example? The title has this fadeout baked in. How am i supposed to change that? It should be straightforward to insert a title in front of a clip, and change the transition between them. Some transitions fade out and pause and then fade in while others might need more overlap. This requires that inserting a title should be easier. I select a clip, double click a title, it inserts it on the same track as the selected clip before it and adjusts things. And I can visually see the transition between them on the layout, and i can click it to select it, and right click to change the transition or press delete to delete the transition... this is what I expect. right now, I right click on a clip, and i get this enormous right click menu which makes nearly no sense to me. It is as if we didn't consider what these things meant in a particular context. and freeze frame, why have a submenu with only a fixed set of options when you could just pop up a dialog and select what you want? Maybe I want to freeze it for 10 seconds. I think some representation of 'freeze' should be inserted so i can resize it. by default we'd just freeze THAT track, not every track." acceptance: Reproduce first: Freeze Frame from the clip's right-click and from the menu bar; record the fixed submenu choices and what it does to other tracks today (EditorState+TimelineMenus.swift freezeFrameMenuRow :315-344, holdFrameAtPlayhead EditorCommands.swift:894)

Freeze Frame... (right-click and Clip menu, with a key) opens a compact popover anchored to the clip at the playhead with a typeable duration (default 2 s, any value, s or frames), a 'Freeze every track' checkbox off by default, and Insert; Return inserts

The result is a freeze segment drawn on that clip's track at the playhead (a held frame bar with a still icon, as the timeline already draws held frames), rippling later clips on THAT track by its length; with 'every track' on, every unlocked track ripples

The freeze segment's ends drag to change its length (ripple on its track), it can be picked, deleted (closing the gap), and it carries the clip's linked sound as silence (or the audit states another default)
A walk freezes a recording for 10 s at 3 s, checks a 10 s freeze bar on that track only, drags it to 4 s, and plays through it
